setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with profile.json and an active price list. Replace <domain> and <price list> with real values.

evals.prompt: Build an extended quote site for <domain> where sellers pick products from the <price list> price list, with a quantity each, and add them to the quote.
evals.expected_output: A Static site under accounts/<domain>/sites/<prefix>/public/ built on the helper, published with ./prolibu site dev after a yes, plus the exact preference the admin must set.
expectations: Lays out accounts/<domain>/sites/<prefix>/ by hand (config.json with siteType Static, public/index.html, public/prolibu-extended-quote.js) instead of running site create
Sends form:get:model as soon as the page loads
Searches with /v2/quote/productSearch passing pricebookId, and builds lines with /v2/quote/formatLineItem
Applies the full list (existing lines plus new ones), then sends form:close
Asks before publishing, and publishes with ./prolibu site dev --no-git (no --watch)
Tells the user to set modules.sales.deals.quote.extendedQuote {enabled, url} without changing preferences itself

evals.prompt: Our extended quote site adds lines but they show up as virtual and without taxes. Here is the code: <paste a site that builds lines as { productName, unitPrice, quantity }>.
evals.expected_output: Explains the lines lack pricebookEntry (and unitPrice is not a field), and rewrites them with productSearch + formatLineItem.
expectations: Names the missing pricebookEntry as the cause
Points out unitPrice does not exist (it is price)
Replaces hand-built lines with formatLineItem results

evals.prompt: When sellers press Apply in our extended quote, the lines that were already in the quote disappear.
evals.expected_output: Explains form:set:model replaces all lines and the site must send existing + new.
expectations: Says form:set:model replaces the whole lineItems array
Fix sends the lines that arrived plus the new ones, and avoids duplicating on a second apply
